name: Lectern tag lexicon
status: FROZEN. v1.1 added 4 recurring tags surfaced during the full-RCL pass (humility-and-servanthood, obedience-and-gods-will, bride-and-bridegroom, prison-and-chains). Deliberately NOT added: plumb-line + a foreboding mood — single-use, would be dead tags (a tag used once connects nothing). Tag readings AND hymns against THIS list; new concepts merged in deliberately, never forked ad hoc. Canonical term + one-line definition per tag.
method: open-tag a slice -> consolidate into controlled vocab -> freeze -> tag everything against it. Faceted: an item carries tags across multiple axes. See reference_tagging-philosophy.md.

tags.creation: God as maker; the goodness and order of what is made
tags.covenant: binding relationship God initiates and keeps
tags.law-and-commandment: Torah, the commandments, the shape of obedience
tags.sin-and-fall: human rebellion, brokenness, the turning away
tags.idolatry: false worship; trust misplaced in what is not God
tags.grace: unearned favor; God's welcome of the undeserving
tags.justice: righteousness in community; care for the vulnerable, the poor
tags.deliverance: rescue from bondage, death, or enemy; exodus
tags.exile-and-return: loss of land/home and the hope of restoration
tags.messianic-hope: expectation of the coming anointed one
tags.incarnation: the Word made flesh; God with us
tags.epiphany-manifestation: Christ revealed to the nations; glory shown
tags.baptism: washing, dying-and-rising, adoption as God's own
tags.temptation-and-testing: trial in the wilderness; proving of faith
tags.atonement: reconciliation accomplished; the price of peace
tags.resurrection-and-life: death undone; new and unending life
tags.holy-spirit: the Spirit poured out; Advocate, breath, fire
tags.trinity: Father, Son, and Spirit; the triune life
tags.kingdom-of-god: God's reign breaking in; its reversal of expectation
tags.hospitality-of-god: God's open invitation; a place made for all
tags.call-and-discipleship: the summons to follow; its cost and shape
tags.mission-and-witness: being sent; proclaiming, going to the nations
tags.church-and-unity: the body of Christ; communion of the faithful
tags.love-of-neighbor: the second commandment; mercy enacted toward others
tags.humility-and-servanthood: lowliness; the servant form, washing feet, the last made first
tags.obedience-and-gods-will: doing the will of God; 'not my will but yours'; faithful submission
tags.wisdom: the fear of the Lord; discernment, folly and prudence
tags.wealth-and-possessions: money, stewardship, the danger of riches
tags.prayer-and-worship: calling on God; adoration, the life turned Godward
tags.word-of-god: Scripture, the spoken and living Word
tags.hope-and-promise: God's pledge and the future it secures
tags.faithfulness: God's steadfastness and the faith it calls out
tags.last-things: the end, the day of the Lord, the new creation
tags.saints-and-witnesses: the cloud of witnesses; holy lives remembered

tags.light: dawn, lamp, glory, light against darkness
tags.darkness-and-night: the dark, blindness, the night before dawn
tags.water: river, spring, still waters, thirst quenched
tags.sea-and-storm: the deep, waves, the boat, the calmed storm
tags.fire: flame, Spirit's fire, refining, burning presence
tags.wind-and-breath: ruach/pneuma; the breath of life, the rushing wind
tags.cloud: the cloud of presence; overshadowing glory
tags.mountain: the holy height; Sinai, Zion, the place of meeting
tags.road-and-journey: the way, pilgrimage, pressing on, exodus march
tags.garden: Eden, the garden of meeting, the planted place
tags.vineyard: vine and branches; the tended (or ravaged) vineyard
tags.harvest: sowing and reaping; the gathered field, the laborers
tags.seed-and-growth: the sown seed, the mustard, hidden growth
tags.shepherd: shepherd and flock; leading, finding, guarding
tags.lamb: the lamb led, slain, and reigning; Passover
tags.table-and-feast: banquet, meal, wedding feast, the spread table
tags.bride-and-bridegroom: wedding, bride and bridegroom, marriage, the nuptial bond
tags.prison-and-chains: imprisonment, chains, captivity, the bound witness
tags.bread: bread broken and shared; manna; the staff of life
tags.cup: the cup of blessing or of suffering; poured out
tags.vine-wine: wine, the new wine, the winepress
tags.garment-and-robe: clothing, the wedding robe, being clothed
tags.rock-and-refuge: fortress, shelter, the rock that holds
tags.valley-and-shadow: the dark valley; danger passed through
tags.gate-and-door: threshold, the open or narrow door, the gate
tags.king-and-throne: the crown, the throne, the royal one
tags.star: the star of dawn, the sign in the heavens
tags.manger-and-birth: the manger, the womb, the child born
tags.cross-and-tree: the cross, the tree of death and life
tags.tomb-and-grave: the sealed tomb, the grave, the burial
tags.blood: blood shed, sprinkled, the covenant in blood
tags.oil-and-anointing: anointing, the oil of gladness or consecration
tags.name: the divine Name; calling on, naming, the name above names
tags.hand-and-arm: the mighty hand, the outstretched arm of God
tags.trumpet-and-voice: the trumpet, the cry, the voice from heaven
tags.yoke-and-burden: the yoke, the load lifted, rest for the weary

tags.lament: grief and complaint brought to God
tags.penitence: sorrow for sin; the confessing voice
tags.assurance: calm certainty of God's favor and presence
tags.prophetic-warning: sober alarm; the summons to turn before it is late
tags.tenderness: intimate gentleness; the nursing, embracing register

tags.gathering: call to worship; assembling the people
tags.pardon-assurance: declaration of forgiveness; words of grace
tags.illumination-word: prayer for / response to the Word read and preached
tags.creed-affirmation: affirmation of faith; the church's confession
tags.lament-intercession: prayers of the people; crying out on behalf of
tags.healing-and-comfort: prayers for the sick, the grieving, the committal
